M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2
July, 2024 
Author: P.Velmurugan Bench: P.Velmurugan  C.S.(Comm.Div  IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT MADRAS  Dated : 02.07.2024  CORAM: 
 THE HONOURABLE Mr. JUSTICE P.VELMURUGAN  C.S. (Comm. Div.) No.36 of 2024  M/s. Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India Private Limited,
 Represented by its Director,
 Anand Krishnan  Having office at No.34,
 Developed Plots (South Phase),
 Industrial Estate, Guindy,
 Chennai  600 032. 
 Vs.
 Vasantha Bhavan,
 No.144, Ennore High Road,
 Tondiarpet, Chennai  600 081. . 
 Civil Suit is filed under Order VII Rule 1 Civil Procedure  with Order IV Rule 1 of the High Court Original Side Rules and Secti  and Section 135 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999, praying for a judgment  decree against the defendant:
 1/14 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  C.S.(Com M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8711508/
1  a) granting a permanent injunction restraining the defenda  men, servants, agents or anyone claiming through or under them from   manner infringing the plaintiff trademark and trading style VASANTA  BHAVAN by using the offending Trademark and Trading style  VASANTA BHAVAN or any other mark or marks which are similar or in  any way deceptively similar to or a colorable imitation of the plain  Trademark VASANTA BHAVAN.
 (b) granting a permanent injunction restraining the de  men, servants, agents or anyone claiming through or under them from   manner passing-off the plaintiff trademark and trading style VASANT  BHAVAN by using the offending trademark and trading style VASANTA  BHAVAN or any other mark or marks which are similar or in any way  deceptively similar to or a colourable imitation of the plaintiffs t  VASANTA BHAVAN. 
 (c) directing the defendant to render a true and faithful   profits earned by them through a sale of food products bearing the o  trade mark VASANTA BHAVAN and directing payment of such profits to  2/14 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  C.S.(C  the plaintiff by way of damages for infringement committed by the  defendant.
 (d) to pass an order of declaration, declaring the plainti M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8711508/
2  trademark Vasanta Bhavan as well-known mark within the meaning of Section 2(1)(zg) read with Section 11(6) of the Trademarks Act, 1999   with a direction to the Registrar of Trademarks to notify the mark V  Bhavan on the register of well-known marks.
 e) directing the defendant to pay the plaintiff the costs   For Plaintiff : Mr.Vijayan Subramanian  For Defendants : Set ex parte on 18.03.2024  JUDGMENT The plaintiff has filed this Civil Suit seeking permanent injunction restraining the defendant from in any manner infringing and passing off the plaintiff's trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN by using the offending Trademark and Trading style VASANTA BHAVAN and to direct t h e d e f e n d a n t t o r e n d e r t h e a c c o u n t o f p r o f i t s e a r n e d b y t h e m t h r o u g h https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 the sale of food products bearing the said trademark and also to declare the plaintiff's registered trademark VASANTA BHAVAN as well-known mark. 
2. It is the case of the plaintiff that in the year 1960, one Muthukrishnan, the father of M.Ravi and grandfather of Anand Krishnan commenced hotel business in the name and style of VASANTA BHAVAN. The plaintiff is also running restaurants along with the prefix Namma Veedu Vasanta Bhavan also. On account of long continuous and extensive use of the unique trademark VASANTA BHAVAN tremendous amount of goodwill and reputation has accrued in favour of the plaintiff's trademark VASANTA BHAVAN. The trademark VASANTA BHAVAN used in conjunction with the hotel business was widely known and very popular among the public. The plaintiff has invested a substantial sum of money in order to create the awareness among the public with regard to the high quality hotel VASANTA BHAVAN. The plaintiff hotel has acquired a turnover of a sum of Rs.7,00,44,76,989/- for the years 2003 to 2021. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 2.1 The plaintiff has taken steps to protect the trademark and trading style by applying for registration of the trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN. It is submitted that the Registrar of Trademarks, Government of India,
Mumbai has issued the certificate of registration on 15.07.2021 for the mark VASANTA BHAVAN in the name of the plaintiff. The plaintiff has also obtained the legal usage certificate dated 19.04.2022 from the Trademark Registry, Intellectual Property building, Guindy, Chennai  600 032. The plaintiff has also taken steps to protect the trademark and trading style by applying for registration of the trademark and trading style NAMMA VEEDU VASANTA BHAVAN. The M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8711508/
3 Registrar of Trademarks, Government of India, Mumbai has also issued the certificate of registration on 27.01.2012 for the mark NAMMA VEEDU VASANTA BHAVAN in the name of the plaintiff. Hence, except the plaintiff no one has any right to use the said trademark and trading style. 
2.2 It is the case of the plaintiff that the defendant herein had commenced adopting identical or deceptively similar trademark and trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN in respect of their hotel business serving veg and non-veg foods. The defendant has adopted the identical trademark https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 and trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN to deceive the general public and to make them believe the food preparations served at the defendant place has the connection with our hotel and the defendant is associated with the plaintiff. The defendant has no manner of right to adopt and use the said offending trademark or trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN. 
3. The learned counsel for the plaintiff submitted that the defendant had commenced adopting identical or deceptively similar trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN in respect of their hotel business only in order to deceive the general public and to make them believe the food preparations served at the defendant place has the connection with the plaintiff's hotel and the defendant is associated with the plaintiff. The defendant has no manner of right to adopt the use the said offending trademark. If the defendant is allowed to continue the illegal acts in adopting the plaintiff's trademark and vend food preparations under the offending trademark, the plaintiff would be put to very serious loss and hardship. There is also danger of the public being cheated by the defendant by adopting the offending trademarks by misleading the public to believe the food p r e p a r a t i o n s b e i n g s o l d b y t h e d e f e n d a n t i n c o n n e c t i n g w i t h t h e p l a i n t i f f . 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 The acts of the defendant also constitute criminal offences under the Trademark Act, 1999. Hence, the present suit has to be decreed with costs. 
4. Despite notice being served on the defendant, they have not chosen to contest the matter. Hence,
the defendant was set ex parte by this Court on 18.03.2024. 
5. In order to prove the case of the plaintiff, the Director of the plaintiff's hotel is examined as P.W.1. 
He had also filed a proof affidavit by reiterating the contents of the plaint filed in support of this suit. Through PW1, 45 documents have been marked as Exs.P1 to P45.
6. Ex . P1 is the advertisement for Vasanta Bhavan in Maalai Malar newspaper dated 24.03.2005 and Exs.P2 to P5 are the advertisement bills issued by various newspaper companies. Exs. P6 to P8 are the advertisement for plaintiff hotel in various dates. Ex . P9 is the certificate issued by the Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drugs and Administration Department. Exs . P10 and P11 are the ISO certificate and trademark registration certificate in the name of the plaintiff's hotel. Ex . P12 is the original board resolution https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 dated 21.03.2024. Exs . P13 & P14 are the legal usage certificate in the name of plaintiff's hotel. Exs . P15 to P18 are the inauguration photos of the plaintiff hotel and defendant hotel. Ex . P19 is the printout of the comparison chart of plaintiff and defendant hotel. Exs . P21, P23, P25, P29, P35 to P38, P40 &
P42 are the advertisement for plaintiff's hotel in various newspapers. Exs. P20 & P24 are the lease M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8711508/
4 deed to run the restaurant named Vasanta Bhavan along with clean copy dated 26.10.1974. Ex . P22 is the lease deed to run the restaurant named Vasanta Bhavan dated 19.10.1979. Exs . P26 to P28 are the copies of receipt received and issued by Krishna Agro Industries Corporation in the name of Vasanta Bhavan. Exs. P39, P41 & P43 are the advertisement bills issued by the various newspapers in the name of plaintiff's hotel. 
7. The defendant neither challenged the averments in the plaint nor challenged the proof affidavit of the plaintiff. Upon hearing the learned counsel for the plaintiff and on analysis of the oral and documentary evidence adduced on the side of the plaintiff, it is clear that the plaintiff has proved its case. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 8. In view of the same, the Civil Suit is decreed with costs.

No.36 of 2024 the sale of food products bearing the said trademark and also to declare the plaintiff's registered trademark VASANTA BHAVAN as well-known mark.
The plaintiff has taken steps to protect the trademark and trading style by applying for registration of the trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN.

2.2 It is the case of the plaintiff that the defendant herein had commenced adopting identical or deceptively similar trademark and trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN in respect of their hotel business serving veg and non-veg foods.
The defendant has adopted the identical trademark https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 and trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN to deceive the general public and to make them believe the food preparations served at the defendant place has the connection with our hotel and the defendant is associated with the plaintiff.
The defendant has no manner of right to adopt and use the said offending trademark or trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN.
The acts of the defendant also constitute criminal offences under the Trademark Act, 1999.
Hence, the present suit has to be decreed with costs.
